players.bio: David Rodríguez Uribe (born May 5, 2002) is a professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder for Canadian Premier League club Atlético Ottawa, on loan from Atlético San Luis. Born in Mexico, he represented the United States national under-17 team.

Franck Boli (born 7 December 1993) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Atletico de San Luis. Boli signed with Eliteserien side Stabæk Fotball on 3 January 2012. The leader of sports at Stabæk Fotball, Inge André Olsen said; "Boli has many qualities, with his technically good finishing and quick pace".

João Pedro Geraldino dos Santos Galvão (Brazil, 9 March 1992), commonly known as João Pedro, is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or an attacking midfielder for Liga MX club Atlético San Luis. João Pedro spent most of his career with Cagliari after signing in 2014, making over 250 appearances and scoring over 80 goals for the club.
Juan Pedro Ramírez López (born 30 April 1991), known as Juanpe, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga MX club Atlético San Luis.

Jürgen Damm Rascón (born 7 November 1992) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a winger for Liga MX club CF América. According to a study conducted by Mexican club Pachuca, and backed by FIFA, Damm is the second fastest player in the world. He is able to reach 35.23 km/h (21.89 mph) running with the ball.

Kevin Ariel Ortega Mercado is a 24-year-old Mexican professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for the Liga MX club Atlético de San Luis. Born on 4 January 2002 in Hermosillo, Mexico, he is a right-footed player known for his defensive work rate in the center of the pitch.
Leonardo Bonatini Lohner Maia (born 28 March 1994) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Liga MX club Atlético San Luis.
Lucas Esteves Souza (born 24 June 2000) is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a left-back for Liga MX club Atlético San Luis.
Robson Alves de Barros (born 12 November 1997), known as Robson Bambu or just Robson, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Primeira Liga club Braga.

Santiago René Muñoz Robles (born 14 August 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Liga MX club Atlético San Luis, on loan from Santos Laguna. Born in the United States, he played for Mexico at youth level.
